note: Consumer view of the response envelope. 200: 'created' (201) case must return error and zero metadata. application/json: 'HTML' and 'absent type' cases red if accepted; charset parameter accepted. JSON object: 'array' case red if accepted. Positive: 200 application/json object yields issuer and jwks_uri. The 'subset of Section 2 values' clause constrains the server; §3.2 says 'Other claims MAY also be returned', so no consumer input violates it.
